entities.summary: Tjaru was an ancient Egyptian fortress on the Way of Horus or Horus military road, the major road leading out of Egypt into Canaan. It was known in Greek as Selē, in Latin as Sile or Sele, and in Coptic as Selē or Slē. It has been suggested that its remains form the Tel el-Habua near Qantarah.
